bio.text: Cordell Cleare has represented District 30 in the New York State Senate since taking office on November 30, 2021, succeeding Brian Benjamin.
She is running for re-election on the Democratic and Working Families Party lines in the November 3, 2026 general election.

Her career has included working as chief of staff to former State Senator Bill Perkins and serving as chair of the NYC Coalition to End Lead Poisoning; she previously held a seat on the Community School Board for District 3.
